title: Proportion of chiral maps with automorphism group $\mathcal{S}_n$ and $\mathcal{A}_n$
summary: Orientably-regular maps are highly symmetric embeddings of graphs in oriented surfaces. Among them, chiral maps are those which fail to be isomorphic to their mirror images. We prove that, as $n\to\infty$, chirality is generic for orientably-regular maps with automorphism groups $S_n$ or $A_n$: the proportion of chiral maps tends to $1$ in both families. We also obtain the corresponding asymptotic result for orientably-regular hypermaps with automorphism groups $S_n$ or $A_n$.
